notes.title: "Where's The Halloween Update?" & Incoming Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
You may be wondering where the Halloween Update is and why the current update is completely and utterly broken. Well I'll be frank with you, I've been having a lot of first-time game dev issues that I'm only encountering now because Roy Rattler far exceeds the scale of anything I've done in the past for both better and for worse. Many of these issues include Unity becoming unstable, code compilation times increasing and the root cause of a number of the bugs you're seeing on your end: Bugs that don't appear in the Unity editor and only appear in exported builds of the game.

All that being said, I am deeply sorry for the state of the game but am dedicated to making sure that the final product of both Roy Rattler and it's demo are good. I have a true love of the mascot horror subgenre and the intent with making Roy Rattler was always to make a mascot horror game with a more ambitious gameplay scope than what's typically seen in this subgenre. In line with that and in line with my goals for Roy Rattler, I'll be releasing a development roadmap tomorrow that details and outlines the future of Roy Rattler's development plans as well as an update that fixes the softlocks that ended up in the current demo.

Until next time,
Kaiju

notes.title: 1.1 Update Released
notes.content: Roy Rattler demo has been updated to 1.1. Still no sound effects due to an unresolved issue that will be corrected in time for the Halloween update. Thanks to all the patient people for their patience!
